name: Caesium
title: Caesium: free TinyPNG alternative
hook: TinyPNG charges you thirty nine bucks a year to shrink your photos. This app does it for free.

features.say: It cuts the file size of JPG, PNG and WebP pictures while keeping the overall quality.
You can shrink the resolution too, so pictures are easier to store, send and share.

caption:
TinyPNG charges $39/year. Caesium shrinks your photos for free 🗜️

✅ Cuts the file size of JPG, PNG and WebP pictures
✅ Keeps the overall quality, and can shrink the resolution too
✅ Easier to store, send and share your pictures
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · or try it in your browser at caesium.app
ℹ️ Mac and Windows have ready-made downloads on GitHub. Linux means building it yourself or using a third-party build. A big v3.0 rewrite is in the works. TinyPNG also has a free web tier with limits, $39/year is its Web Pro plan
